description: MNTN page and conversion image calls on px.mountain.com/sti. Checks advertiser identity, required cache-buster and populated page URL or conversion amount. Conversion identity and value may be omitted for non-revenue conversions; randomness, GA integration and product mapping need surrounding context.

params.name: shaid
params.description: The documented advertiser identity is required. It is usually numeric, so no numeric-only grammar is imposed.

params.name: cb
params.description: A nonempty cache-buster is required. The documentation permits arbitrary unique values.

params.name: conv
params.description: The published conversion example uses 1. Zero is accepted as a page-view flag.

params.name: plh
params.description: Optional absolute page URL, including iframe context.

params.name: shoid
params.description: Order or acquisition identity. The manual guide permits unmapped non-revenue conversions.

params.name: shoamt
params.description: A populated acquisition amount is numeric. The manual guide permits omission for non-revenue conversions.

params.name: shadditional
params.description: The image guide describes comma-separated key=value pairs. Custom names and values remain open.
